incidents.recent.statement: SELECT id, title, body, started_at, resolved_at FROM incidents ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

incidents.since.statement: SELECT id, title, body, started_at, resolved_at FROM incidents WHERE started_at > ?1 ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

pings.receive.statement: INSERT INTO pings(source, payload, received_at) VALUES(?1, ?2, ?3)
